banter: Yes?
Don't you have better things to do?
I'm listening.
Hmm?
Go on.
Is something wrong?
Focus on the creatures.
The work continues.
Don't waste time.
I'm still here.
Need something?
Keep going.
Stop.
If you tap me again I will count it as an attack.
I have been alone for ages. This is not the company I pictured.
The creatures are suffering. You are... tapping.
Yes, I see you. I saw you the last twelve times.
Do not look at me like that. I am concentrating. On not yelling.
Every tap costs a creature somewhere. Probably. I have not checked the math.
I used to have dignity. Then you found the portrait.
Speak. Or don't. The silence was better, actually.
I am the Keeper of the wilds. Not a button.
The corruption spreads. So does your curiosity. Only one of those is my job.
Why must you poke me so...
Please stop...
This isn't funny...
Still not funny...
I asked you to stop.
That was not a suggestion.
You are doing this on purpose.
I can feel you enjoying this.
My suffering is not a pastime.
Poke the creatures. They at least do something.
Again? Truly?
I will outlast you. I have ages. You have a finger.
Stop. Stop. I am begging, and I do not beg.
If this is affection, I decline.
The barrier was supposed to keep people out. It failed me.
One more tap and I start charging rent.
I smiled once. It was before you.
Funny would be you leaving.
Still here. Still poked. Still not amused.
I am keeping a tally. You will not like the tally.
